name: active fault zones
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 可能发生构造错动的断裂区域。

complete_examples.text: However, due to the large number of active fault zones (AFZs) in western China, track structures inevitably need to be laid in fault zones.

Presently, China is advancing the construction of HSR infrastructure in western high-altitude and seismic regions [4–6], where one of the foremost challenging geological conditions encountered is the presence of active fault zones (AFZs).
